metadata.description: The Guava Stack for business owners and solo operators: a shared AI context hub (Notion, Google Drive, OneDrive/SharePoint or local Markdown), a planner + worker model router, and founder-mode.

plugins.name: guava-hub
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. Sets up a shared AI Context & Skills Hub in Notion, Google Drive, OneDrive/SharePoint or local Markdown, so all your AI assistants share your context, rules and skills. Part of the Guava Stack.

plugins.name: guava-router
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. Routes thinking work to a planner model and doing work to a worker model through their CLIs, on the plans you already pay for. Defaults to Claude Opus 5.5 + GPT-6.1 Sol; also works with ChatGPT only, Claude only, or tools like Cursor, Droid and Amp. Part of the Guava Stack.

plugins.name: founder-mode
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. 27 working rules so your AI assistant handles the safe work on its own and always checks with you before anything that could cost you money or can't be undone. Part of the Guava Stack.
